history.summary: Kali Mandir of Naharlagun is the Kali shrine in E Sector, Naharlagun (geocoded address 'Kalibari, Naharlagun 791110'; location listing 'Kali Mandir, E Sector, Naharlagun, AR' at approx 27.1035, 93.6945). It has a modest but verifiable public footprint: JustDial lists 'Kali Mandir, Esector Cona Naharlagun' as a religious organisation, and the Vivekananda Kendra Arun Jyoti Itanagar branch held a personality-development camp at 'Kali mandir, Naharlagun' on 7 January 2012 for students of Govt. Higher Sec. School Polo Colony and Kendriya Vidyalaya No.1 Naharlagun. No founding history, deity installation story, or opening hours are published - flagged. IMAGE SEARCH FAILURE: image searches returned Kali temples in Maharashtra, Guwahati and Siliguri rather than this Naharlagun shrine, so media is empty.

name: Kali Mandir
town_description: Naharlagun is a town in Papum Pare district, Arunachal Pradesh, adjacent to the state capital Itanagar and part of the Itanagar Capital Complex. It is the main commercial and transport hub of the capital region, with Naharlagun railway station linking Arunachal to the rest of India. E Sector is a residential sector of Naharlagun town.

travel.road: E Sector is within Naharlagun town on the NH 415 corridor (verify).

visitor_information.opening_hours: Not published (verify - confirm locally). Kali Puja (October-November) is the main festival period for a Kali shrine.
